Macedonian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈpanda]

Noun

[edit]

панда • (panda) f (diminutive пандичка)

  1. (zoology) panda

[edit]

Moksha

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Cognate with Erzya пандо (pando). (This etymology is missing or incomplete. Please add to it, or discuss it at the Etymology scriptorium.)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /pɑndɑ/[1]
This entry needs an audio pronunciation. If you are a native speaker with a microphone, please record this word. The recorded pronunciation will appear here when it's ready.

Noun

[edit]

панда • (panda)

  1. (geography) hill, mountain
    • O. Je. Poljakov (1993) Russko-mokšanskij razgovornik [Russian-Moksha phrasebook], Saransk: Mordovskoje knižnoje izdatelʹstvo, →ISBN
      Мон кельгса морять (вирть, панттнень)
      Mon keľgsa moŕ[ä/a]ť (virť, panttńeń )
      I love the sea (the forest, the mountains)
